messages:
samir: quick sync on the "rate-tamer" edge filter prototype. goal: soften short high-rps probing without touching central quota rules. need feedback on the hint API and rollout.

maria: prefer advisory hints (score + backoff array + reason) not pre-admit. keeps rollback safe.

aaron: agree. add confidence and metric_tag so downstream alerts can slice by cause. make schema versioned v1.

jyoti: infra: per-node LRU <=64k, async heavy-hitter feed. p50 budget <2ms. add per-region kill-switch and canary plan.

samir: testing: perf harness, replay attack sims, FP target <0.5%. ops-bot: schedule canary?

ops-bot: canary scheduled 2025-03-04T10:00Z region=us-west-2 pct=1
